why: यथा॒जौ is yathā + ājau (sandhi), a normal form.
विश्वान् केताँ is the accusative plural before a vowel-initial word; regular.
अधि॒पा भ॑वे॒ह is adhipā bhava iha; the 3 is a pluti/svara digit.
दे॒वाँस्त्वं is devān + tvam with the usual nasalised sandhi.
विश्वे॑षु is a regular locative plural; the ह्ल/ळ्ह spelling varies within this edition.
होता॑सि is hotā asi (sandhi), fits the verb forms of the line.
होता॑रः is the nominative plural matching आसते and स॒प्तजा॑मयः.
होता॑र ऋ॒त्विज॑: is hotāraḥ with visarga sandhi before ṛ.
दा॒शुषे ऽग्ने॑ keeps the edition's spaced avagraha and the accent shift after elision, as in the next line.
सं भ॑रन्ति is a regular 3rd plural; sense fits.
भ॑रता is the 2nd plural imperative; regular.
वि भ॑रन्ते is a regular middle 3rd plural; spaced avagraha is edition style.
प्र भ॑रध्वं is the 2nd plural middle imperative; regular.
अनु॒ष्ठाः is a rare but well-formed word (anu-ṣṭhā); nothing else in the line is off.
इ॒मान् पश्य॒न् is the accusative plural before a consonant; regular.
इ॒माम् is the feminine accusative singular; regular.
परि॒धिं is a regular accusative; sense fits रु॑जन्ति.
प्रति॒मै is a rare form but nothing in the line shows a typing slip.
वृषा॑सि is vṛṣā asi, parallel to वृ॑ष॒भः in the same line.
मन॑सि is the locative; त॒न्व१मा has a svara digit, not an error.
पृथि॒वीम् is the accusative, object of अ॒भि (ब॒भूव॑).
गिर॑स्त is giraḥ + te with visarga sandhi; regular.
इन्द्रो॒त is indra + uta (sandhi); regular.
उप॒मां is a regular accusative agreeing with के॒तुम्.
उप॒ब्दैः is a well-formed instrumental plural.
उप॒मा is a dual form matching द्वा; no half-verse mark is the chapter's style.
उप॒माँ is the accusative plural with nasalised sandhi before उ.
मा॒तायं is mātā + ayam (sandhi), parallel to पि॒ताऽयं.
स॒हस्रा ऽत्कं is sahasrā + atkam with the edition's spaced avagraha.
पि॒तान्धं is pitā + andham (sandhi); regular.
राजा॑सि is rājā asi; regular.
राजा॑नः is the nominative plural matching कृ॑ण्वा॒नाः.
इन्द्रा॑द् भि॒या is the ablative before bh; regular.
रा॒येषां is rāye + eṣām (sandhi); regular.
महि॒म्नः is the genitive of mahiman; regular.
महि॒षाँ is the accusative plural before a vowel; regular.
महि॒म्ने is the dative of mahiman; regular.
नाम॑भिः is a regular instrumental plural; the 3 is a pluti digit.
म॒हीम् is the accusative agreeing with पृथि॒वीं.
वसु॑न इ॒नस्पति॑: is vasunaḥ with visarga sandhi; regular.
वसु॑ना is a regular instrumental; regular.
वसु॑माँ is vasumān before a vowel; regular.
परा॑च is parācaḥ with visarga sandhi before आ; regular.
परा॑सः is a regular nominative plural agreeing with पि॒तरः.
मधु॑नः is the genitive of madhu; regular.
मधु॑ने is the dative of madhu; regular.
परा॑चः is a regular accusative plural; sense fits.
महि॑षी is the queen, subject of जजान; regular.
हव॑ना is the neuter plural, object of जु॒षेथां.
हव॑नं is the accusative; regular.
हव॑ते is a regular 3rd singular middle.
स॑वि॒ताभि is savitā + abhi (sandhi); regular.
ब्रह्म॑णः is the genitive; regular.
ब्रह्म॑णां is the genitive plural; regular.
स॑वि॒त्र is savitre with the final vowel elided before इन्द्रा॑य; regular.
स॑वि॒त्रा is the instrumental; regular.
अच्छा॑न्त is a well-formed aorist; regular.
वरु॑णा is the vocative dual-type form in इन्द्रा ... वरुणा; regular.
अव॑तां is the 3rd dual imperative with रोद॑सी; regular.
नम॑सि is the locative; regular.
